pull.title: KAFKA-20803: Demultiplex batched persister responses once ( initialize state handler)
pull.body:
Follow-up to https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/22835 for [KAFKA-20803](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-20803).

* Remove repeated scans of batched initialize state responses.
* Build one shared PartitionResultIndex per batch and let initialize state handler  look up its result by topic ID and partition.
* It Reduce demultiplexing from O(N ^ 2) to average O(N), using O(N) temporary indexing memory while preserving payloads, errors, and retries.
